en.row.accountsHint: Copies this plugin keeps of every Trae sign-in on this machine (mirrored on refresh). Refresh after signing in, or Trae's next sign-in overwrites that login. Tokens are never shown.
en.row.accountsNone: This region reports no usable account.
en.row.accountsRefreshedNone: Accounts refreshed: no usable Trae account found
en.row.checkinDeviceSpent: This machine already used today's check-in — Trae allows one per device per day, so this account cannot claim here today. Claim it on another device or from the account that checked in, or come back tomorrow.
en.row.checkinDisabled: This account has no check-in activity available.
en.row.contextAllDefaultHint: Clears every context-budget override in this region, so all models go back to Trae's default window. Still a draft — press Save to apply.
en.row.contextAllMaxHint: Sets the DSH context budget of every model in this region that has a Max window to its Max window at once. Still a draft — press Save to apply. Models without a Max window are left alone.
en.row.creditPositionHint: Where the credit readout sits. "composer toolbar" is the default (the row with the model picker). Choose "below the input box" — the row carrying the round / step / token statistics — if another plugin occupies the composer toolbar and the readout does not appear.
en.row.creditsAlternative: Another account on this machine still has credit: {accounts}
en.row.creditsExhausted: The bound account ({account}) has run out of credit
en.row.desc: Use Trae models in DSH and see your remaining credits; the domestic and international sides are two independent providers, each with its own account — use both at the same time.
en.row.enterpriseCreditsNotice: Enterprise spend is not reported here. The Trae client cannot read the tenant balance — every enterprise quota endpoint answers 404 — so the only place to see it is the enterprise console (console.enterprise.trae.cn). The personal credit figure is deliberately NOT shown on this tab: it belongs to the consumer pool and would be misread as the tenant balance.
en.row.expiryWarningLapsed: {total} credit has already lapsed but is still counted in the balance ({packs} packs)
en.row.modelCapabilityPending: Image input follows Trae's own multimodal flag, plus anything you tick yourself.
en.row.modelImageAuto: Enabled automatically: Trae marks this model multimodal.
en.row.modelsTestAllHint: The「test all」button probes every model in the catalog, enabled or not, so it spends noticeably more quota than the enabled-only run.
en.row.modelsTestEmpty: Enable at least one model first.
en.row.modelsTestHint: Sends one minimal message per enabled model to see which ones actually answer. Costs a small amount of quota.
en.row.poolActionNoteNoMembers: Tick the accounts you want in the pool and save first.
en.row.poolActionNoteTestNone: No free model resolves in this panel — pick a target model before testing.
en.row.poolBusyHint: Working through accounts one at a time…
en.row.poolCopyFile: Copies live in {path} — {count} right now. Switching accounts in Trae adds a copy; it never overwrites an existing one.
en.row.poolDeleteAppRunning: Nothing was changed: {apps} is running, and it would write the login back over the file on exit. Quit {apps} completely, then delete again.
en.row.poolDeleteHint: The plugin keeps its own copy of every local Trae login (a copy is created on refresh unless one already exists) and only ever shows and bills those copies. Delete removes the copy AND signs that account out of Trae itself, leaving a backup of every file it rewrites; a deleted account is not re-imported while it stays signed in Trae. A running Trae would flush its own state back over the file, so quit it first — the card names the app it needs closed.
en.row.poolDeleteNoCopy: There was no plugin copy of {accountName} left to delete — it only exists as a Trae app login, and that sign-out did not take effect.
en.row.poolDeleteStillSigned: Deleted this plugin's copy of {accountName}, but it is still signed in to Trae, so the account itself is not gone. Sign out inside Trae to remove it from this machine.
en.row.poolEnabledHint: The pool picks the account to bill for this panel's requests, ranking by credits and availability. Off means the manually bound account serves.
en.row.poolErrCheckinUnsupported: this panel does not offer a daily check-in
en.row.poolErrMethod: the pool does not accept that request method
en.row.poolErrNoFreeModel: no free model is available for this panel
en.row.poolErrNoLiveMembers: every member is unavailable — nothing can serve
en.row.poolErrNoMembers: the pool has no members to act on
en.row.poolErrOrigin: the page is not the plugin's own page, so the request was refused
en.row.poolErrTargetStale: the saved target model is no longer offered
en.row.poolErrUnavailable: the pool is unavailable right now
en.row.poolGhostDeleteAria: Delete the saved but unreachable account {accountName} from this machine
en.row.poolGhostMembers: {count} saved member(s) no longer resolve to a local sign-in: {names}
en.row.poolLogNoMembers: Nothing to do — no pool members are selected.
en.row.poolLogSaveFailed: Could not save the pool settings.
en.row.poolLogTargetCleared: Returned the test target to automatic.
en.row.poolLogTimeout: The test did not answer in time — it was cancelled, so the button works again. Check the network and retry: {message}
en.row.poolManualAccountHint: Used while the pool is off. With it on, the Host picks by credits.
en.row.poolNoCandidate: No usable pool member can serve this panel right now.
en.row.poolNoCandidateEmpty: No pool members are selected yet.
en.row.poolNoCandidateEmptyHint: Tick accounts in the membership list to bring them into the pool.
en.row.poolNoCandidateHint: Traffic keeps landing on the saved selection until one recovers.
en.row.poolNoCandidateUnusable: Every selected member is unavailable right now.
en.row.poolNoCopyTestHint: This machine holds no sign-in for this account, so it cannot be tested. Sign in to Trae with it again to recreate a copy, or delete the row.
en.row.poolOffNotice: The pool is off — the bound account is what serves. Turn the switch below on to let the pool decide.
en.row.poolProbeSizeHint: How much text a test sends. A one-word probe only proves the account can answer a one-word request — if the upstream refuses long turns, this is where you find out. Bigger is closer to a real conversation, and costs more credit on every account in the batch.
en.row.poolRowDeleteAppRunning: Could not delete {accountName}: {apps} is running and would restore the login. Quit {apps} completely, then delete again.
en.row.poolRowDeleteAria: Delete {accountName} from this machine: the plugin's copy and its Trae app login (this will sign it out of Trae)
en.row.poolRowDeletedSignedOut: Deleted {accountName} and signed it out of {apps}.
en.row.poolRowDeleteNoCopy: {accountName} had no plugin copy — only its Trae app login
en.row.poolRowDeleteStillSigned: removed this copy, but {accountName} is still signed in to Trae
en.row.poolSettingsHint: The switch and the target model are preferences — save them. Test, check in and delete act at once.
en.row.poolSettingsNote: Preferences below take effect when you save; test results are written by the plugin and are not affected by that button.
en.row.poolTargetHint: The model a probe test uses.
en.row.poolTargetNone: No free model available for this panel
en.row.poolTargetNoneHint: The pool can only pick a free model; none resolves right now, so tests are disabled.
en.row.poolTargetStale: Model {model} is no longer offered by this panel
en.row.poolUnsavedMembers: Unsaved membership changes — Save below to apply.
en.row.poolWorkHint: Work credits are not spendable by DSH — only General powers chat.
en.row.refreshTokenExpiring: Sign in to Trae again by {expiresAt} ({days} day(s) left) — automatic renewal stops after that.
en.row.refreshTokenLapsed: Automatic renewal has stopped: the Trae sign-in expired {expiresAt}. Sign in to Trae again to restore it.
en.row.searchedHint: No sign-in was found. These locations were probed; if your Trae stores its login elsewhere, please report the path.
en.row.showPointsInMainUi: Show credits in the composer row
en.row.showPointsInMainUiHint: A clickable readout in the composer tool row while a model from this plugin is selected: Trae CN · <balance> on the CN side, Trae Global · <plan> on the international one.
en.row.showPointsInMainUiHintAi: A clickable readout in the composer tool row while a model from this plugin is selected: Trae Global · <plan>.
en.row.signedOutHint: Sign in once in the Trae desktop app; this plugin follows that sign-in automatically.
en.row.tabEnterpriseHint: Enterprise bills the tenant pool of the same Trae CN account instead of the personal one. It never falls back: a refusal is reported as an error rather than quietly spending personal credits.
en.row.tabHint: Three independent providers, each with its own account, usage, and models. All are live at once and never affect each other.
en.row.tabOffNotice: This provider is off: its models are not offered to DSH. Account and settings are kept.
en.row.tabSwitchHint: Turns this provider off: its models leave the DSH picker. Account and settings are kept.
en.row.title: Trae credits & models (dsh-connect-trae)
en.row.transferExportPick: Choose which of the {total} account copies to export.
en.row.transferHint: The exported file holds this plugin's own copies, including live tokens — treat it as a password. Records belonging to the other region are skipped.
en.row.transferImportPick: This file holds {total} record(s). Ticked records are added as plugin-owned copies; the Trae app is not touched.
en.row.transferVeilHint: The account list refreshes when this finishes.
